clock.rounding: durations in ns are converted to T units by t_config.t_units (one shared writer)

timing_ns.note: qualification values of the ctl_m10_* configs; the held-OPERATE block uses held_operate_overrides

ports.note: the ctl_m10_* configs' ports_map: both software endpoints on device port 9 (VEPA hairpin); no physical relay in this profile

encoding.output_octets_note: SELECT/OPERATE image (the control-timing contract field); the READ image is read_output_octets
encoding.control_partition_note: the 22 native SELECT/OPERATE application octets split 15/6/1 into transport frames 28/19/14

_note: two-READ-target build (m12p_c21): N/T values unchanged from m11_09 (T segment and timing parameters inherited); encoding: SELECT/OPERATE output 61 (output_octets); READ images per native length (read_images): mixed 91->141 and full 247->271 by the pipe-1 egress prefix (G1V2 points 1024..). Other READ lengths are not padded; arbitrary input sizes are not supported.
